title: Bari Category Page Output v1
description: JSON Schema derived from the union of granola_frontend_v1.json and snacks_frontend_v2.json (the two working BariProductVM-based corpora). Milk uses a separate legacy format (milk-comparison.json) not covered here.

product_count.description: Number of product objects in the products array

scored_count.description: Number of products with a non-null score

id.description: Unique product identifier (bsip1_<type>_<barcode> or snk-NNN format)

imageUrl.description: Product image URL; null when unavailable

score.description: Bari score 0-100; null for INSUFFICIENT products (float accepted)

confidence.description: Data confidence level (3-state v2 + verified for milk)

nutrition.description: Per-100g nutrition values. All sub-fields nullable: null = data unavailable. Present on every product (may be all-null).

ingredients.description: Full ingredients text. Null when unavailable.

servingNote.description: Serving size annotation, e.g. ל-100 גרם

limitingFactors.description: 0-2 compositional limits (Hebrew strings). Absent when no limits identified.

unknowns.description: Data gaps Bari could not verify (Hebrew). Category-level invariant.

caveats.description: Product-level caveats (Hebrew). Not yet present in any corpus.

bottomLine.description: Editorial synthesis — בשורה התחתונה (Hebrew). Category-level invariant.

consumerExplanation.description: Extension field: structured consumer explanation (pre-copy or object).

rowVerdict.description: 2-3 sentence editorial verdict on the collapsed row. Category-level invariant.

rowReason.description: Short strongest +/− for collapsed row. Synthesized by page-data layer, not in source JSON.

metrics.description: Display-only metric block. Synthesized by page-data layer, not in source JSON.

brand.description: Manufacturer/brand name, display-only. Null/absent when unknown (never fabricated). Live in bread/hummus/cheese/granola/snacks/etc. since TASK-431 and the 2026-06-27 brand-beside-title rollout (c666b4f3); added here to close a schema-lag gap (G1 previously failed on every category already shipping it).

barcode.description: Product barcode (13-digit Israeli or internal code)

d4_additives.description: D4 additive tier entries. Empty array when not gated.

d3_processing.description: D3 processing signal. Absent when not gated.

glassBox.description: Glass Box D5/D6 presentation state. Absent when not gated.

s_grade_explanation.description: Pre-authored Hebrew explanation for S-grade products. Absent on non-S grades.

novaGroup.description: NOVA group 1–4; null when not assessed. (TASK-316 render field)

sugarPer100ml.description: Sugars per 100ml for liquid categories (juices). (TASK-316 render field)

kcalPer100ml.description: Calories per 100ml for liquid categories (juices). (TASK-316 render field)

_source_retailers.description: Source retailer list (cakes schema alias). (TASK-316 render field)

_category_routed.description: Cakes category routing decision from trace.category. (TASK-316 render field)

_product_type.description: Hummus product sub-type (e.g. hummus_spread, matbucha). (TASK-316 render field)

_has_phvo.description: True if PHVO/PHCS detected in L3 inferred classifications. (TASK-316 render field)

d3_processing_signal.description: Residual null: not in trace_writer output; requires engine edit out of scope for TASK-316.

_website_cluster.description: Internal website-clustering hint (consumed by frontend page-data; not consumer-rendered scoring data). Whitelisted 2026-06-18 — was a stray-property G1 failure.

_novaGroup.description: Extension field: NOVA group (underscore-prefixed variant used by hard_cheeses + milk extension_fields config). Whitelisted 2026-06-18 — was a stray-property G1 failure.

_subPool.description: Extension field: sub-pool classification (underscore-prefixed variant used by hard_cheeses + milk extension_fields config). Whitelisted 2026-06-18 — was a stray-property G1 failure.

rank.description: 1-based rank of this product within the displayed shelf (scored by Bari score descending). Present on every scored product. Whitelisted 2026-06-22 — ShelfContextSection component requires it; confirmed present on all live categories.

categoryTotal.description: Total number of displayed products in this category page. Used by ShelfContextSection to render 'X out of Y' shelf context. Whitelisted 2026-06-22 — confirmed present on all live categories.

nameHe.description: Hebrew product display name authored by Content (nameHe required per category; null only when genuinely unretrievable). Whitelisted 2026-07-01 for crackers go-live — TASK-433.

_hash_no_rank.description: Internal provenance hash of the product record excluding rank (membership-correction reproducibility marker; not consumer-rendered). Whitelisted 2026-07-01 — emitted by bread_frontend_v4 membership correction, TASK-433.

page_copy.description: Page-level authored copy block (consumed by frontend page-data; not a per-product scoring field). Whitelisted 2026-06-18 — was a stray-property G1 failure.
